title: swertia lutea
intro: Swertia lutea, commonly known as Yellow Swertia or Yellow Indian Gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Himalayan region, for its diverse health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Swertia lutea include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve liver function, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Swertia lutea include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and other flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in treating various health conditions.
